content.text:
**What the error means**

On the test site, the forgot-password screen tried to send an OTP. Before it sends the WhatsApp message, the app saves the code in a database table called `otp_sessions`. It doesn't store the plain code, only a scrambled version in a column called `code_hash`. The **staging (test) database doesn't have that column**, so the save failed and the screen showed this message. No OTP was sent to 7893074271.

So this is a **database setup problem, not a code bug, and not a problem with the phone number.** It shows "TEST SITE" at the top, so only staging is affected.

**One thing in the message is wrong:** it says to run `scripts/whatsapp-otp-migration.sql`, but no file with that name exists. The correct file is **`scripts/whatsapp-migration.sql`**. Line 17 of that file adds the missing column:
```sql
ALTER TABLE otp_sessions ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS code_hash text;
```
The wrong file name is written in `src/app/api/otp/send/route.ts:103`.

**How to fix it**
1. Open the **staging** Supabase project (egaquepinrgzzyfazppr) → SQL Editor.
2. Paste in all of `scripts/whatsapp-migration.sql` and run it. It's safe to run more than once.
3. Try "Reset password" again on the phone.

**Two things to know:**
- `scripts/MIGRATION-STATUS.md` says this migration was already run on staging. This error shows it wasn't, or it didn't finish. I tried to check the staging database myself but Supabase said I don't have permission, so I couldn't confirm.
- On prod this migration is marked as not run yet. If staging goes to prod without it, password reset will break on the real site the same way. Please run it on prod before the merge.

Should I also fix the wrong file name in the error message?

It's safe to click **Run query**, but only if the editor has `scripts/whatsapp-migration.sql` in it. Supabase shows this warning whenever a query contains the word "DROP".

In our file, the only line with that word is line 25:
```sql
ALTER TABLE otp_sessions ALTER COLUMN session_id DROP NOT NULL;
```
This doesn't delete any data. It only makes the old `session_id` column optional. The new OTP flow doesn't fill that column, so without this change OTP saving would fail again. Everything else in the file only adds things: new columns and the `notifications` table. No table, row or column gets removed.

**Before you click, please check one thing.** Behind the popup I can faintly see text like `public.academic…` and `student.status`. Those names are not in our project. -- ================================================================
-- YFF Payments: one place to see every payment and its status
-- Run in: Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor → New Query → Run
-- ================================================================
--
-- There is no payments table: payment details live on each `orders` row
-- (payment_status, payment_method, gateway ids, refund columns), and every
-- payment_status change is already logged in `order_events`
-- (event_type = 'payment_change'). These are VIEWS over `orders`, not copies,
-- so they can never drift out of sync and need no trigger.
--
--   payments                -- one row per order: buyer, farmer, amounts, status
--   payment_status_summary  -- count + amount per payment_status
--
-- Reading the numbers:
--   • is_successful = payment_status 'paid' or 'completed' (the code treats the
--     two the same).
--   • A refund does NOT change payment_status — the order stays 'paid' and only
--     refund_status/refund_amount are set. net_received subtracts the refund.
--   • verified_by: 'gateway' = Cashfree/Razorpay confirmed the money;
--     'farmer' = a COD/UPI order the farmer (or rider) marked as paid.
--   • buyer_paid = produce + delivery fee + platform fee (same sum as
--     src/lib/orderReport.ts). total_price alone is the produce price.
--   • A multi-farmer checkout is ONE payment but several order rows;
--     COUNT(DISTINCT payment_ref) counts real payments.
--
-- Not readable from the app: security_invoker makes the view obey the caller's
-- rights on `orders`, and anon/authenticated get no grant at all. Read it from
-- the SQL Editor or the Table Editor (service role).
--
-- Safe to re-run (dropped and recreated — views hold no data).

DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.payment_status_summary;
DROP VIEW IF EXISTS public.payments;

CREATE VIEW public.payments
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  o.id                                    AS order_id,
  o.order_code,
  COALESCE(o.checkout_id, o.id)           AS payment_ref,
  o.created_at,
  -- who paid
  o.buyer_name,
  o.buyer_phone,
  -- who was paid
  f.name                                  AS farmer_name,
  f.phone                                 AS farmer_phone,
  f.village                               AS farmer_village,
  f.account_type                          AS farmer_account_type,
  o.is_self_order,
  -- what and how much
  o.produce_name,
  o.quantity,
  o.unit,
  o.total_price                           AS produce_amount,
  o.delivery_fee,
  o.platform_fee,
  COALESCE(o.total_price, 0) + COALESCE(o.delivery_fee, 0) + COALESCE(o.platform_fee, 0)
                                          AS buyer_paid,
  COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0)            AS refund_amount,
  CASE WHEN o.payment_status IN ('paid', 'completed')
    THEN COALESCE(o.total_price, 0) + COALESCE(o.delivery_fee, 0) + COALESCE(o.platform_fee, 0)
         - COALESCE(o.refund_amount, 0)
    ELSE 0
  END                                     AS net_received,
  -- status
  o.payment_method,
  o.payment_method_detail,
  o.payment_status,
  o.payment_status IN ('paid', 'completed') AS is_successful,
  CASE
    WHEN o.payment_status NOT IN ('paid', 'completed', 'deposit_paid') THEN NULL
    WHEN COALESCE(o.cashfree_payment_id, o.razorpay_payment_id) IS NOT NULL THEN 'gateway'
    ELSE 'farmer'
  END                                     AS verified_by,
  o.paid_at,
  CASE
    WHEN o.cashfree_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'cashfree'
    WHEN o.razorpay_order_id IS NOT NULL THEN 'razorpay'
  END                                     AS gateway,
  COALESCE(o.cashfree_order_id, o.razorpay_order_id)     AS gateway_order_id,
  COALESCE(o.cashfree_payment_id, o.razorpay_payment_id) AS gateway_payment_id,
  o.utr_number,
  o.cod_deposit,
  o.cod_balance_due,
  o.cod_deposit_paid_at,
  o.cash_collected_at,
  o.refund_status,
  o.refunded_at,
  o.status                                AS order_status
FROM public.orders o
LEFT JOIN public.farmers f ON f.id = o.farmer_id;

CREATE VIEW public.payment_status_summary
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  payment_status,
  COUNT(*)                    AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT payment_ref) AS payments,
  SUM(buyer_paid)             AS buyer_paid,
  SUM(refund_amount)          AS refunded,
  SUM(net_received)           AS net_received
FROM public.payments
GROUP BY payment_status;

REVOKE ALL ON public.payments, public.payment_status_summary FROM anon, authenticated;

-- verify:
-- SELECT * FROM payment_status_summary ORDER BY orders DESC;
-- SELECT verified_by, COUNT(*), SUM(net_received) FROM payments WHERE is_successful GROUP BY 1;

content.text:
I've changed the view so the buyer's name and phone now come right after the amount:

`produce_name | quantity | unit | produce_amount | buyer_name | buyer_phone | delivery_fee | …`

So the ₹3000 Aavu Neyyi row will show who ordered it, right next to the amount.

**What you need to do:** the change is only in the file so far, not in the database yet. To apply it:
1. Supabase → **SQL Editor** → paste in all of `scripts/payments-view-migration.sql` → Run.
2. You'll see the same "destructive operations" popup again, because the file starts with `DROP VIEW`. It's safe to click **Run query**. A view only shows data from the `orders` table and doesn't store anything itself, so no data is lost.
3. Open the `payments` table again in the Table Editor.

**Good to know:**
- Run it on staging first, then on prod if you want it there too.
- If a row shows **TRUE** in the first column (`is_self_order`), the farmer ordered their own produce, so the "buyer" will be the farmer.
- The buyer details were already in the view before, just far to the left near `created_at`. This change only moves them next to the amount.
- I made the same change in `scripts/staging-schema.sql` too, so the two files stay in sync. `payments-view-migration.sql` is still not committed in git.

CREATE VIEW public.payment_status_summary
WITH (security_invoker = true) AS
SELECT
  payment_status,
  COUNT(*)                    AS orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT payment_ref) AS payments,
  SUM(buyer_paid)             AS buyer_paid,
  SUM(refund_amount)          AS refunded,
  SUM(net_received)           AS net_received
FROM public.payments
GROUP BY payment_status;

REVOKE ALL ON public.payments, public.payment_status_summary FROM anon, authenticated;
